script: When she texts "I'm hungry," never reply, "Eat something." She's not asking for advice. She's giving you an opening. A woman doesn't remember the guy who gave her advice. She remembers the one who took her out. "Order food" is what every guy says, and he just missed the date of his life. Next time, try one of these four. Number one: "I know a place that will change your life. Come hungry." It turns a text into a plan, with a little mystery. Number two: "Tacos or sushi? Choose wisely. Your answer says a lot about you." It's playful, and now you're already planning dinner together. Number three: "Careful, hungry people make bad decisions, like saying yes to dinner with me." It's warm, confident, and she'll laugh. Number four: Skip the questions. Be ready at eight. It's short, direct, and pure initiative. She'll often say yes before she thinks about it. So stop replying with something else. Now comment the word HUNGRY, and I'll send you the exact messages.
